description: Check a token before you buy it: one call bundling quantitative rug-check metrics (holder concentration, permissions, liquidity), AI risk assessment with market data, and current gas — rolled into a proceed/caution/avoid verdict with reasons. Cheaper than calling the three services separately. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.
name: trade_check
